integrity: Full mathematical proof and exact countable density are provided; computational tests are finite and not used as an infinite proof. Authorship and independent validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Distribution is proved only for integers uniformly sampled in complete four-adic blocks of the specific base-four complementary digit pair. No global natural-density law or universality across complements is asserted. Equivalence to unindexed earlier work remains possible.
title: An absolutely continuous four-adic law at the sharp additive-complement threshold
